chosen.poseName: local +x down (gusset end face on the bed)
chosen.why: The gusset end face on the bed, as the V1.22 base and the 10/07 candidate: the motor mating face, the four output seats and the cut face stand vertical. Bambu: every MUST face clean.
chosen.objectSettingsReason: pipeline R1 brim rule (objectSettingsSource in the slices)

Bambu.objectSettingsSource: R1 default: tip angle 2.4 deg < 10 deg, outer brim

Elegoo.objectSettingsSource: R1 default: tip angle 2.4 deg < 10 deg, outer brim

chosen.mustExplanation: Bambu: every MUST face clean. Elegoo only: Orca's tree support reaches into the d4.4 counterbores of the motor-output screws from the plate exterior and touches 1.1 (left) / 9.7 (right) mm2 of the seat floors, plus 0.3 mm2 of the motor face and 1.3 / 2.4 mm2 of the cut face. On an Elegoo print, pull the tips out of the four counterbores with tweezers so the M2 x 4 heads sit flat. A teardrop roof on these holes was rejected: on the hole beside the shaft the roof would point at the d5 centre aperture and leave 0.4 mm of wall (stock 1.3 mm).

brim.brimInsideHullAllowanceReason: The gusset end face on the bed carries the real 12 x 1.1 mm recess of the stock bracket (community-66/64 notch beside the gusset hole); the outer half keeps part of it. Bambu Studio loops the 4 mm outer brim into it: 2.4 mm2 inside the convex outline on both outer halves, a strip bonded on three sides, cut it out with a blade. Orca puts support feet there instead. Same notch as the V1.22 bases (13.3 mm2 there). Not an opening filled with brim.

rejected.-x down (left): Bambu: 7.6 mm2 of support on the motor mating face; Elegoo: 7.8 mm2 on the output seats (slices/left_outer/mx-down).
rejected.+-z down: the motor face or the four output seats face down onto support 2-3 mm above the bed; the plate exterior is 7 deg off the shaft.
rejected.-y down: the foot-block underside has no flat face (prepare finds no planar contact).

chosen.poseName: heel chamfer down (shaft flat, teardrop roof up)
chosen.why: The stock heel chamfer (55 mm2, at 150 deg round the shaft) on the bed: the shaft lies flat and the new 45 deg teardrop roof of the d15 pocket and the d14 lip bore points straight up into the 11.7 mm thick toe-and-foot corner, so the bearing pocket, the capture lip and the lip bore print with 0 mm of support inside on both machines. The support stands under the foot-block arm (cosmetic; the foot socket slides over the block's underside and sides, 109 mm2 of it touched on Bambu, file if it binds).
chosen.objectSettingsReason: pipeline R1 brim rule (objectSettingsSource in the slices)

Bambu.objectSettingsSource: R1 default: tip angle 6.8 deg < 10 deg, outer brim

Elegoo.objectSettingsSource: R1 default: tip angle 6.8 deg < 10 deg, outer brim

chosen.mustExplanation: Bambu only: 0.8 mm2 of the cut face touched by the support under the arm. The cut face meets the other half with 0.2 mm between them, so a support scar there cannot change the fit. Elegoo: every MUST face clean.

brim.brimAlongSupportReason: The support under the foot-block arm stands on the bed beside the heel chamfer (330 / 230 mm2 of first-layer support on Bambu / Elegoo). Both slicers brim that support too, so the brim reaches 9-12 mm from the part; the part's own brim (outline nearer the part than the support) reaches 2.7 mm on Bambu, trimmed by the nearby support, and 4.5 mm on Elegoo.

rejected.+x down: before the teardrop roof: 11.3 / 14.3 mm2 of the d15 pocket wall on support and 197 / 766 mm of support inside the pocket (Bambu / Elegoo).
rejected.-x down: before the teardrop roof: 12.8 / 21.1 mm2 of the pocket wall on support, 276 / 527 mm inside the pocket.
rejected.-z down (cut face on the bed): the plate inner face overhangs 15 mm and its support fills the pocket: 64.7 mm2 of the pocket wall and all 22.8 mm2 of the capture lip on support, 869 mm inside (Bambu).
rejected.+z / tilted exterior down: the 1.2 mm sleeve lip ring stands proud of the 7 deg exterior, so no flat face is lowest.
